errors.text: The proposed Al addition and B2 phase do not reconstruct the demonstrated Cr addition and approximately 4 vol.% Cr2(Ti,Zr,Hf,Ta) Laves phase.
The baseline density is incorrectly stated as greater than 12 g/cm³ rather than approximately 10.44 g/cm³.
The density prediction is physically inconsistent: Al is less dense than Ti as well as Hf and Ta, so a minor Al addition would not intrinsically produce the claimed density increase.
The cited evidence does not establish that 2–5 at.% Al in Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr forms an Hf/Ti-Al-rich B2 reticulated network or that such a brittle network bridges cracks.

The falsification experiment does not distinguish solid-solution hardening from phase-structure strengthening because it lacks lattice-parameter or strain measurements, dislocation-density characterization, and a phase-free Al-bearing control.
